notes.title: Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown Patch 1.4.0 | Mask of Darkness
notes.notes:
Prince of Persia™: The Lost Crown [b]Update 1.4.0[/b] was deployed on all supported platforms on the [b]12th of September 2024[/b]. It was pushed ahead of the DLC release to ensure that all players who purchase Mask of Darkness will  be able to play the new adventure on release.

This update contained a list of changes and new additions to the base game , but most notably laid the groundwork for the new integrated story DLC Mask of Darkness. If this latest update was not automatically applied before starting the game, see to manually update your game using the dedicated platform service. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/0930af3cd11bc46442a750e2e6e69b975ecdbd48.jpg[/img]
[h2]1.4.0 - UPDATE DETAILS[/h2]
[u][b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/u] [list]
[*]1 new, free outfit inspired by [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717880/The_Rogue_Prince_of_Persia/]The Rogue Prince of Persia[/url][/b] – automatically unlocked for all players. [/list][u][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/u]
Addressed: [list]
[*]The game gets stuck on invoked map if map button is spammed after exiting any of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2751000/view/4221643401510237267]Divine Trials[/url]  challenges.² 
[*]In a rare incident, the damage zone of an Ice Boulder gets stuck in a place in front of a sand jar in Tower of Silence, rendering the player impossible to collect it.
[*]At times when fighting Menolias, players can accidentally slip out of the boss arena by sliding under Menolias’ Magic Barrier.²
[*]Using the ‘Fabric of Time’ ability from a distance on a bridge in the Tower of Silence doesn't remove the one way icon on the map. [/list][u][b]ACCESSIBILITY AND OPTIONS[/b][/u]
Addressed: [list]
[*]“Legend” input prompt shows up in menu when “High Contrast Mode” is enabled. [/list] [i]²Addressed with the help of player feedback or notification.[/i]

[u][b]UPDATE SIZE[/b][/u] [list]
[*]PC (Steam): 5.68GB  
[*]PC (Ubisoft Connect): 6.33GB
[*]Nintendo Switch: 1.10 GB
[*]PlayStation®5: 2.48GB
[*]PlayStation®4: 4.63G
[*]Xbox One: 4.33GB
[*]Xbox Series X|S: 11.25 GB
[*]Luna: 6.33GB [/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
[h2]DLC & Complete Edition[/h2]
The new story DLC Mask of Darkness will be [b]available September 17[/b] at a recommended price of 4.99 EUR/USD. Alongside this DLC, the Complete Edition and Complete Edition Upgrade will be available for purchase to all players of the Standard and Deluxe Edition.

[b]The Complete Edition[/b] (Upgrade) includes the Mask of Darkness DLC, the two new outfits inspired by Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones and all content previously exclusive to the Deluxe Edition. The Deluxe Edition and upgrade will ultimately be replaced by the Complete Edition and upgrade following September 17.

The new DLC and Add-Ons will also be available for individual purchase.

[u][b]DLC [/b][/u][list]
[*]A whole new story line accessible from The Haven
[*]3 new biomes (Radjen’s Mind Palace )
[*]1 new, main villain & 3 new bosses
[*]3 new Amulets
[*]5 new enemy types, 
[*]>10 new gameplay elements for fresh puzzle & platform experiences [/list] [b][u]ADD-ON[/u][/b] [list]

notes.title: Hotfix: Save Synchronization
notes.notes:
As planned last week, a new hotfix was just rolled out earlier today. 

With this 167.94MB hotfix, a major issue resulting in the loss of progress should be resolved. 

Again, thank you for raising this issue and sharing all the details and specificities with our support teams on all platforms. It helped us greatly in identifying the cause of the problem. 
 
[b][u]What was happening?[/u] [/b]
The automatic upload of the save into the cloud had a chance to fail in some cases, causing synchronization issues. This could lead to conflicting save states, resulting in a loss of progression. 

[b]Now, [/b] with this latest hotfix, [list]
[*]Auto save upload has been disabled to avoid further issues. [/list]
In case you would need it, [b]manual saving into the cloud is still possible[/b] via the in-game Save Management menu. You can copy your save into the "Cloud save slot". Just don't forget to upload your save before closing the game. 

💡[i]Please be mindful that if this latest hotfix was not automatically applied before starting the game, see to manually update your game. [/i]

Thank you so much for your help, patience, and confidence. 

Your Prince of Persia Community Team

notes.title: Hotfix: Saving the game & visual indicator
notes.notes:
With this 163.7MB hotfix, a major issue resulting in the loss of progress should be resolved.
Thanks to all of you flagging the issue, but also sharing details and specificities on it with our support teams. It’s because of your input that our developers were able to publish this hotfix as early as today.

[h3]About the issue[/h3]
In some rare cases a game could be stuck in an endless attempt to save the game and indicating that it succeeded in doing so, when in fact it was stuck in an ongoing loop of attempts. 
Closing the game while the loop was ongoing would result in the loss of progress.

[b]Now[/b], the following issues were addressed with this latest hotfix: [list]
[*]Game stuck in endless loop, attempting to save the game at a Wak-Wak Tree.
[*]Visual “saving in progress”-indicator disappearing while the process was not actually finished. [/list]💡[i]Please be mindful that if this latest hotfix was not automatically applied before starting the game, see to manually update your game.[/i]

[h3]Full transparency[/h3]
While this fix resolves the mentioned issues, delivering a solution to the vast majority of reported cases where progression was lost, [b]it does not solve them all[/b].

To address other known, but less frequent cases where progress is lost, our teams continue their work on a fix planned to be published next week. So, please keep your eyes open for future updates to the game. 

Thank you so much for your help, patience and confidence.


Your Prince of Persia Community Team

notes.title: Content Update 3: Divine Trials
notes.notes:
Yet another free content update? 
Well, you got that right!  

Make way for content update number three: Divine Trials. 

[previewyoutube=Ke-pi068EXg;full][/previewyoutube]

With this third update, we added twenty-two freshly hand-crafted challenges meant to truly test your skills. Pushing you to your limits! 

These challenges are a well-rounded mix of platforming, brain teasers, combat or spiced-up Boss Battles each with their own set of unique modifiers and original conditions. 

In short, it’s everything that you’ll come to love of Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown, but in a compact and spicy form. And rest assured, there won't be any easy victories this time! 

Since these trials will require unlocked time powers in your active playthrough, they will only unlock over time as you progress through the main story. 

[h3][b]Totally new challenges [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
The Divine Trials can be accessed via a special door in the Haven (I know it really is a hub for everything). It will only appear after having gained the Rush of the Simurgh (Air dash) time power. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/63f5e4c1e086c4c9ca774babcc6a31ef98472752.png[/img]

Once you enter the special door you will be led to a mystical room containing 4 Memorials, one for each set of challenges. Or 1, or 2 or 3, it all depends how far along into the story you are.  

The Memorials are: 
[list]
[*] The Hound 
[*] The Peacock 
[*] The Stallion 
[*] The Auroch 
[/list]
And of course, once a Memorial is unlocked, you can play them in any order you like. Each one of them features a unique boss battle as a final challenge. 

Once defeated, you’ll be granted the Memorial's reward: a new Amulet and a new Outfit for Sargon. All of which unique to the challenges and fully usable in the main story. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/f277285275a0c2497d6ded93aa988c540825a994.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Each challenge is unique [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
Each trial is carefully handcrafted with modifiers to create exciting challenges deeply different from anything else in the game. 

[list]
[*][b] Specific set of modifiers:[/b] Trials can present unique mechanics not used in the game. For instance, one is a Time attack: a timed platform challenge, with each killed enemy on the way adding a few seconds to the timer.  
[*] [b]Specific setup for each Trial:[/b] Your loadout is pre-fixed, independent from your regular gear in the game: number of potions, equipped amulets, and life bar. Some challenges will even forbid the usage of the bow, or of specific Time Powers. ([i]whaaaaaat?![/i]) 
[*][b]Platform & Puzzle Challenges[/b]: Feel like the platforming and puzzles following the story are too easy? Just you wait.... 
[*] [b]Combat Challenges:[/b] These very often require fighting waves after waves of enemies without dying - and most often without potions. ([i]insert the tears of the community manager here during these[/i])  
[*][b] 4 Revised Bosses:[/b] Fight Erlik, Jahandar, Kiana and ??? anew, but this time with extra attack patterns - and a fixed loadout to begin with. ([i]don’t worry you will know all about these bosses soon™[/i]) 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/14ee89ef30e3ce4272bf9c9d789ab3811c4692e7.png[/img]

[h3][b]4 new Amulets to unlock: [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
The new Amulets can be used outside of the challenges, in the rest of the game, once unlocked. However, they cannot be upgraded, contrary to their main story Amulet counterparts. 

[list]
[*] [b]Arash's Quiver:[/b] Arrows quiver automatically refills over time - goes back up to 5 arrows, independently of max capacity. 
[*] [b]Flaming Whirlwind:[/b] Charge your attack and unleash a storm of blue fire. Replaces the regular charged attack. 
[*] [b]Point of Honor:[/b] After hitting enemies several times in a row your next arrow shot is stronger.  
[*] [b]Frozen Truth: [/b]Hold down the Parry button for a few seconds to charge an ice protection that will partially protect you from the next attack. Once hit, it explodes in a small AoE ice attack that freezes enemies nearby. The ability vanishes after a few seconds if not triggered.
[/list] 
[b]All Trials are compatible with difficulty presets/customized difficulty. The Platforming Help Option can be enabled during platforming sequences. [/b]

Note: Speedrun mode timer keeps running normally in the Trials. Also, dying in a Trial while in Permadeath mode doesn't trigger the Permadeath. 

[list]
[*] [b]The exclusive outfits get unlocked across all existing save files once obtained while the Amulets remain exclusive to the save slot. [/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Fashion Week [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
It's not a content update without some new outfits for Sargon. This one brings 4 new outfits! 

Let's take a sneak peek, shall we? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/2f69ac3c183596d68d6b3b5b8b50051ed717c407.jpg[/img]

Okay, Sargon with the tattoos, I see you. 
 
Whew, that was a long read, but that’s it for now! 
 
Bye, 
Your Prince of Persia Community Team

notes.title: Content Update 2: Boss Attack
notes.notes:
Metroidvanias need to have fun and exciting bosses, which is exactly why we thought we‘d give you the chance to encounter those bosses in Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown [b]AGAIN[/b]. So, if you were silently hoping to fight those bosses more than once - this update is for you. 

Lucky for you, the Steam release includes this and the other free updates right out of the box—no additional waiting needed. 
[previewyoutube=e5pk7FgR4w4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b][h3]Boss Revenge[/h3][/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
Boss Revenge gives you the ability to be able to try those boss fights again (looking at you Manticore...) 
[list]
Here is how it works: 

[*][b]Gradual unlock:[/b] After beating each Boss, they are unlocked in the Boss Revenge menu, which our trusty friend Artaban has in the Haven (don’t worry you’ll learn all about the Haven later). In this challenge, you will enter each Boss Battle with a preset (Life / Weapon Upgrades / Time Powers)  

[*][b]Pick your level of challenge:[/b] For each Boss, you can choose the difficulty you want to play them against: Rookie/Warrior/Hero/Immortal or No Hit. This choice is independent from the current game difficulty. 

[*][b]Prove your skills and beat your records:[/b] A seal is displayed once you've beaten a Boss in a set difficulty.[/list] [b][h3]Boss Rush [/h3][/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
The greatest challenge awaits the bravest: the Boss Rush. This challenge only comes once you complete the game, where you test your abilities and skills by defeating all the main bosses in a row. And not only do you get bragging rights to yourself of how amazing you did, but you can get two outfits from it! 
[list]
[*][b]Endgame challenge:[/b] The Rush gets unlocked after finishing the main story. In this challenge, you will enter with your current life/Amulets/Weapon Upgrades and Athra surges.
 
[*][b]Fight all Bosses in order:[/b] The fights unfold in the same order as in the main story. 

[*][b]Pick your level of challenge:[/b] For each Rush, you can choose the difficulty you want to play against: Rookie/Warrior/Hero/Immortal or No Hit. This choice is independent from the current game difficulty. 

[*][b]Manage your resources:[/b] The amount of Life / Potions / Arrows or Athra gauge left is kept from one battle to the next. You'll need to plan your rush, and use the possibility to change your Amulets & Athra Surges loadout between each fight wisely. Some Amulets are not active in Boss Rush to keep the experience balanced. 

[*][b]Prove your skills and beat your own records:[/b] A seal is displayed once you've beaten the complete Boss Rush in any difficulty, alongside the time taken to do so. Beating the challenge on a high-difficulty setting also unlocks the seal for the lower-difficulty ones. There's a possibility there's a secret seal...
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/a74f2fc23750ebccd99099c1ebefd1271a14511d.png[/img]
[b][h3]Fashion Week [/h3][/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
I know, I know the Sands of Time outfit was fire, but we have another banger for you with this update! Only, this one you have to work for. 😎 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/a3d3013f558b48a7ac13f52f1e8b382dd7df7e72.jpg[/img]
Oh, that skin looks familiar 👀 

[b][h3]Quality of Life [/h3][/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/5c8190543ab75627dd64b296a5c995ea6c1a5fec.png[/img]
Some changes were brought with this update, and since the update will already be at your fingertips, you get to them right away! 
[list]
[*][b]Wak-Wak trees fast travel:[/b] Instantly travel from one Wak-Wak tree to another, without the need to use Fast travel Altars. This ability must be purchased in the Magi Emporium in the Haven (Mage shop) and is unlocked after obtaining the Fabric of Time power. 
[*][b]High contrast mode accessibility improvement:[/b] improvement on attack readability (yellow vs red enemy attacks) 
[/list] [i]Whew, that was another awesome free update if I do say so myself. [/i]
 
Talk to you soon, 

Your Prince of Persia Community Team.

notes.title: Content Update 1: Warrior’s Path
notes.notes:
Metroidvanias need to be difficult they say, which is exactly why we thought we‘d crank Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown up a bit more. So, if you were silently hoping for more punishing modes like beating this game on a single life - this update is for you 

Lucky for you, the Steam release includes this and the other free updates right out of the box—no additional waiting needed. 
[previewyoutube=ksFSDweW7vc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Permadeath Mode[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/11c5b933b3ff36c4fba761a911aae9c958c48681.png[/img]
We know you on Steam love to push yourself to the limits, but how about a real challenge? 
Introducing Permadeath Mode: Play the game with only one life and no second chances! 

[i]You read that right; when you die with this game modifier applied, you must start a new game. [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/1a402c327f6786427505d3f715dd72a63ca79e7b.png[/img]
If you succeed in beating the game with this mode enabled, not only will you have earned massive amounts of respect from our development team, but you'll also receive a pretty sick outfit.  

Oh, but wait, regular permadeath isn’t enough of a challenge for you? Try beating the game in Immortal Permadeath mode! This means more enemy damage, greater enemy health, traps that hit harder, and a much smaller window of opportunity to get that cut scene animation when you successfully parry. 

[h3][b]Speedrun Mode [/b][/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/11c5b933b3ff36c4fba761a911aae9c958c48681.png[/img]
Beating the game is not enough. It has to be done fast. Luckily we created this mode for you to measure up against your fellow speed-maniacs. 

Introducing Speedrun Mode: race against time to beat your own records and keep track of your best attempts at completing the game as quickly as possible.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/f44d226ec50659af21b72c83babfc6a7c7237657.png[/img]
Beat the set time to earn a new outfit and bragging rights among your friends and fellow Prince of Persia fans! 

[h3][b]Fariba's Hints [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/11c5b933b3ff36c4fba761a911aae9c958c48681.png[/img]
Fariba will quickly become a helpful friend and guide in your journey. With this update Fariba's hints were added to the game. As you stumble upon Fariba in each biome and purchase the map pieces you can visit her in the Haven afterwards and give her even more time crystals! But this time for a treasure map, which will show you all the locations of all the chests, (honestly, so helpful) 

After finishing the main story of the game, a special map can be purchased to Fariba: it unveils all the lore items that remain to be found in the game, throughout Mount Qaf. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/c096482dd109e437bc9bd8b3570a51fa7889a1fc.png[/img]
[h3][b]Quality of Life[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/11c5b933b3ff36c4fba761a911aae9c958c48681.png[/img]
With this update, there were some quality-of-life changes! 
[list]
[u]Most notably:[/u]
[*]Custom Difficulty parameters range extended 
• • Notably: The Parry Difficulty can now be set to "Very Easy" 
[*]Enemy Damage and Enemy Health have wider ranges 
[*]New option to 'Hide the HUD' 
[*]New option to adjust background Audio level. 
[/list]

[h3][b]Fashion Week [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/11c5b933b3ff36c4fba761a911aae9c958c48681.png[/img]
We heard you like outfits, so, how about something with a touch of nostalgia? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058788/368dd83593da0f77101d89374f856d9bb284e2a2.png[/img]

This new outfit for Sargon will be unlocked immediately from the first free content update. 
However, the other outfits will require great effort to obtain. 

That’s it for this content update, whew lot’s of fun stuff was added.  
[i]p.s. are any of you going to start your very first save on Immortal Permadeath mode?[/i] 👀 
 
Kindly, 
Your Prince of Persia Community Team
